z44_structure_check.interpretation: max_deviation ~ 0 (machine precision) confirms, by direct matrix computation rather than assertion, that every SU(5)_A generator acts on the (5_A, 10bar_B)-type pieces as (matrix on 5_A) KRONECKER (scalar x I_10) -- i.e. the SU(5)_B family block is carried along completely rigidly and identically for every entry, with zero mixing into family indices. This is the operational definition of a bare tensor product, and is structurally the OPPOSITE of what Z43 found for the SU(9)-tensor (8,8) piece, where color and family indices were provably inseparable (no basis choice could write an (8,8) state as color-part KRONECKER family-part). Verdict: SU(5)_A x SU(5)_B is NOT a plethysm-type construction. It is mechanism-identical in kind to E6 x SU(3)_f (Z6-Z42) -- a product-type maximal subalgebra with family sitting in an untouched separate tensor factor.

z44_comparison.final_verdict:
SU(5)_A x SU(5)_B is mechanism-identical IN KIND to E6 x SU(3)_f (Z6-Z42): a product-type (Levi-type) maximal subalgebra of a larger group, with the family factor appearing as a genuinely separate, untouched tensor block attached rigidly to every SM piece (Task 3, verified to machine precision, not assumed). It is NOT the new structural class Z43 found for the SU(9) TENSOR embedding, because SU(5)_A and SU(5)_B never share a carrier space the way the two SU(3) factors did inside 9=3(x)3 -- there is no plethysm here, by construction, and Task 3 confirms this operationally rather than just citing the definitional argument.

On the freedom count specifically (Task 4), SU(5)xSU(5) does not weaken the obstruction -- it STRENGTHENS it. The residual freedom to rotate within the untouched family block once SM gauge symmetry is imposed is 200 complex dimensions here, vs 1 for gauged SU(3)_f in Z21 (same solver, cross-checked against Z21's own known result before trusting it on this case). Family sits in a 10-(or 5-)dimensional block here instead of a 3-dimensional one, and nothing analogous to gauging SU(3)_f has been imposed on it in this construction -- so of course the commutant is larger; that is exactly the point. Fixing a '3-generation direction' inside a 10bar_B or 5bar_B block that isn't even 3-dimensional to begin with would require an additional, unmotivated choice of embedding or projection -- precisely the Rule 1 violation Task 5 was checking for, and it is present here in an even more acute form than in Z42 (there the flavon at least lived in a 3-dimensional space; here 'three generations' isn't even a distinguished number until something extra is imposed).

CONCLUSION: SU(5)_A x SU(5)_B does not escape the obstruction found in Z6-Z42. It reproduces the same class of mechanism (product embedding, factorized matter, externally-chosen generation direction) and is quantitatively worse (larger residual freedom, no natural '3' at all). This branch is CLOSED, negative, L1 (every claim above checked directly by computation in this phase, not asserted). No update to the project ZIP, handoff, related-work, freeze document, or tracking files is warranted, per Z44's own stated criterion -- this is not a genuinely new result, it is confirmation that the O2 filter's 'worth_heavy_followup' flag on this branch was a false positive at the cheap-filter level, now correctly closed at the expensive-computation level.
